title: Skeleton archer
wikitext:
A '''skeleton archer''' is a type of [[undead]] [[monster]] ([[skeleton]]) found throughout [[Wraeclast]] that attacks with a [[bow]].

==Abilities==
*Undead
*Ranged Attack
